question: When Luffy met Bonney he called her "Boggy", but he quickly changed it to "Bonney". Is there any particular reason for this?
answer: Indeed, it's featured in the panel on the right, but before that, when Luffy heard that Bonney's father had been turned into a cyborg, he was excited and said "that's cool!" He regretted that, and he called her "Boggy" and was immediately corrected, which made him feel so bad. Even Luffy won't make that mistake twice.
name: Machan
